newsitem.title: USA: Small businesses get record Pentagon awards - Cohen.
newsitem.headline: Small businesses get record Pentagon awards - Cohen.

text.p: U.S. Defense Secretary William Cohen said Thursday small U.S. business firms received $25.3 billion in prime defense contract awards in fiscal 1996, a record 23.7 pct of military funding awarded by the Pentagon.

Cohen also said in an announcement that the Defense Department continued to increase its awards to small, disadvantaged business firms with a total of $6.9 billion in prime contracts to such firms in the business year ending last September.
The U.S. military awarded a total of $107 billion in prime contract awards for weapons, supplies and services in the last fiscal year, the Pentagon said.
